description: Summarise and label support tickets with an AI model, reusing earlier answers only where history shows it doesn't change the outcome

provider.help: simulated (offline, no key), anthropic or openai; for a real model also add "api_key": "{{ env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}" to both AI steps

settings.prompt:
Summarise this support ticket in one sentence:
{text}

summarise.note: Free text: its tolerant reuse is judged by whether 'classify' changes its label

settings.prompt:
Which kind of request is this support ticket?
{summary}

settings.message: {{ classify.count }} tickets labelled; {{ by_label.count }} kinds of request
